result.note: Tested the BRICS summit venue; the trade talks themselves are only possible, with no formal position announced.

questions.prompt: Which city was scheduled to host the BRICS summit on 12-13 September 2026?
questions.explain: India hosted the BRICS summit in New Delhi on 12-13 September 2026. Before it, the Commerce Ministry consulted Indian industry groups about Chinese restrictions on rare-earth magnets, battery technology, solar equipment and specialised power-transmission components.
questions.source: Ahead of the Brazil, Russia, India, China, and South Africa (BRICS) summit in New Delhi next week (12-13 September), the Commerce Ministry consulted Indian industry groups about Chinese restrictions on critical technology and components.
